description: Update `agent`'s global configuration dynamically. These are the ungrouped (root) field names; the agent routes each into its group (webhook_url -> notifications.webhook, webhook_key -> notifications.webhook_key, docs_enabled/logs_enabled/log_days -> settings), so a read afterwards shows them nested. log_days controls how long log entries are kept (0-30, clamped; 0 clears the log immediately and keeps only the last hour). docs_enabled is Pi-only. Changing api_key changes the agent's authentication key immediately, and also updates the local agents-config.json file to match automatically.
name: mcp_config_write
